newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Complete Management buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Complete Management buy.

text.p: -- National Securities Corp said it reiterated its buy rating on Complete Management Inc.
-- Last week, the company reported fourth quarter earnings of $1.5 million or $0.17 a share, below National Securities' estimate of $1.9 million or $0.19 a share.
-- Significantly higher than expected general and adminstrative costs and taxes impacted net income, but shares outstanding were lower than projected, analyst Steven Kornfeld said in a report.

-- Currently, Complete Management, a physician practice management company, has a mix of 45 percent primary care and 55 percent specialty care physicians. As it moves to its goal of 70 percent primary care and 30 percent injury related specialty practices by the end of 1997, its collection period will continue to improve, Kornfeld said.
-- Kornfeld said he believes Complete Management is a "compelling investment opportunity," given the company's strong position in New York State and its share price of 10.7 times 1997 estimates.
